cuisine.en: The restaurant is famous for its traditional Thai cuisine and friendly service.
cuisine.zh: 这家餐厅以传统泰国菜和友好的服务闻名。

starter.en: I'll have the soup as a starter, followed by the grilled fish.
starter.zh: 我先点汤作为开胃菜,然后要烤鱼。

main-course.en: The main course comes with rice or potatoes and a small salad.
main-course.zh: 主菜配米饭或土豆,还有一份小沙拉。

dessert.en: Would you like to see the dessert menu after your main meal?
dessert.zh: 用完正餐后,您想看看甜点菜单吗?

beverage.en: Hot beverages are served in the hall during the morning break.
beverage.zh: 上午休息时,大厅里供应热饮。

buffet.en: Breakfast is a buffet, so you can help yourself to whatever you like.
buffet.zh: 早餐是自助餐,想吃什么可以自己取。

takeaway.en: We were too tired to cook, so we ordered a Chinese takeaway.
takeaway.zh: 我们累得不想做饭,就点了中餐外卖。

canteen.en: The staff canteen serves hot meals from twelve until two o'clock.
canteen.zh: 员工食堂从十二点到两点供应热餐。

cafeteria.en: You can get a cheap lunch at the cafeteria on the ground floor.
cafeteria.zh: 你可以在一楼的自助餐厅吃到便宜的午餐。

catering.en: A local company will handle the catering for the conference next month.
catering.zh: 下个月会议的餐饮服务由当地一家公司负责。

vegetarian.en: As a vegetarian, I find it hard to eat out in this town.
vegetarian.zh: 我是素食者,在这个镇上外出吃饭很难。

vegetarian.en: Does the menu include any vegetarian dishes for our guests?
vegetarian.zh: 菜单上有适合我们客人的素菜吗?

vegan.en: Our new chef offers a separate menu for vegans and people with allergies.
vegan.zh: 新厨师为严格素食者和过敏人群提供单独的菜单。

allergy.en: Please tell the waiter if you have an allergy to nuts.
allergy.zh: 如果你对坚果过敏,请告诉服务员。

dairy.en: She can't eat dairy, so we'll need a cake made without butter.
dairy.zh: 她不能吃乳制品,所以我们需要一个不含黄油的蛋糕。

gluten.en: This bread is made without gluten and is safe for people with coeliac disease.
gluten.zh: 这种面包不含麸质,乳糜泻患者可以放心食用。

seafood.en: The town is known for its fresh seafood, especially crab and oysters.
seafood.zh: 这个小镇以新鲜海鲜闻名,尤其是螃蟹和牡蛎。

poultry.en: The butcher sells beef and lamb as well as poultry from local farms.
poultry.zh: 这家肉店卖牛羊肉,也卖来自当地农场的禽肉。

ingredient.en: All the ingredients in our soups come from farms in the area.
ingredient.zh: 我们汤里的所有原料都来自本地农场。

recipe.en: A friend gave me her recipe for chocolate cake last weekend.
recipe.zh: 上周末,一位朋友把她的巧克力蛋糕食谱给了我。

portion.en: The portions here are huge, so one dish is enough for two people.
portion.zh: 这里的分量很大,一道菜够两个人吃。

nutrition.en: The talk on nutrition will explain how to plan a healthy weekly menu.
nutrition.zh: 营养讲座会讲解如何规划一周的健康菜单。

protein.en: Beans are a cheap source of protein for people who don't eat meat.
protein.zh: 对不吃肉的人来说,豆类是便宜的蛋白质来源。

carbohydrate.en: Athletes often eat more carbohydrates before a long race.
carbohydrate.zh: 运动员在长距离比赛前通常会多吃碳水化合物。

vitamin.en: Oranges and other fresh fruit contain plenty of vitamin C.
vitamin.zh: 橙子和其他新鲜水果含有丰富的维生素 C。

calorie.en: This salad has fewer calories than most of the other lunches on the menu.
calorie.zh: 这份沙拉的卡路里比菜单上大多数午餐都低。

fibre.en: Brown bread contains more fibre than white bread and keeps you full longer.
fibre.zh: 全麦面包比白面包含有更多纤维,更耐饿。

organic.en: The shop sells organic vegetables grown without any chemicals.
organic.zh: 这家店出售不使用任何化学品种植的有机蔬菜。

tip.en: Service isn't included, so people usually leave a tip of ten percent.
tip.zh: 服务费不含在内,所以人们通常留百分之十的小费。

tip.en: The guide gave us some useful tips on where to eat cheaply.
tip.zh: 导游告诉了我们一些去哪儿吃得便宜的实用建议。

receipt.en: Keep your receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
receipt.zh: 保留好收据,以防你需要退鞋。

discount.en: Students can get a ten percent discount if they show their cards.
discount.zh: 学生出示证件可以享受九折优惠。

voucher.en: This voucher gives you £5 off your next meal at the restaurant.
voucher.zh: 这张代金券可以让你下次在这家餐厅用餐时减 5 英镑。

bargain.en: This coat was a real bargain at half the original price.
bargain.zh: 这件大衣打对折,真是捡了个便宜。

bargain.en: Tourists in the market often bargain with the sellers over prices.
bargain.zh: 市场里的游客经常和小贩讨价还价。

purchase.en: You can return any purchase within thirty days if you have the receipt.
purchase.zh: 凭收据,任何购买的商品三十天内都可以退货。

purchase.en: Customers can purchase tickets online or at the door on the night.
purchase.zh: 顾客可以在网上购票,也可以当晚在门口购买。

cashier.en: Please pay the cashier at the front of the shop before you leave.
cashier.zh: 离开前请到店铺前方的收银员处付款。

checkout.en: There was a long queue at the checkout, so I used the machines instead.
checkout.zh: 收银台排着长队,所以我改用了自助机。

in-stock.en: Is this jacket still in stock in a larger size?
in-stock.zh: 这件夹克还有大一点的尺码吗?

out-of-stock.en: I'm afraid that model is out of stock until next month.
out-of-stock.zh: 恐怕那个型号要到下个月才有货。

warranty.en: The washing machine comes with a two-year warranty on all parts.
warranty.zh: 这台洗衣机所有零件都有两年保修。

guarantee.en: The camera has a one-year guarantee, so keep your receipt safe.
guarantee.zh: 这台相机保修一年,所以请保存好收据。

guarantee.en: We guarantee delivery within three days or we'll give your money back.
guarantee.zh: 我们保证三天内送达,否则退款。

delivery.en: Delivery is free on all orders over fifty pounds.
delivery.zh: 订单满五十英镑一律免运费。

retailer.en: Most large retailers now allow customers to order online and collect in store.
retailer.zh: 现在大多数大型零售商都允许顾客网上下单、到店取货。

wholesale.en: The shop buys its goods at wholesale and sells them at a higher price.
wholesale.zh: 这家店以批发价进货,然后以更高的价格出售。

merchandise.en: The band sells T-shirts and other merchandise at the back of the hall.
merchandise.zh: 乐队在大厅后面出售 T 恤和其他商品。

second-hand.en: I bought a second-hand bike from a student who was leaving.
second-hand.zh: 我从一个要离校的学生那里买了一辆二手自行车。

department-store.en: The department store has clothes on the first floor and furniture on the top.
department-store.zh: 百货商店二楼卖衣服,顶楼卖家具。

shopping-mall.en: The new shopping mall has over a hundred shops and a cinema.
shopping-mall.zh: 新购物中心有一百多家商店和一家电影院。

stall.en: We bought some fresh cheese from a stall at the Saturday market.
stall.zh: 我们在周六集市的一个货摊上买了些新鲜奶酪。

cutlery.en: The cutlery and plates are on the table by the door.
cutlery.zh: 刀叉和盘子在门边的桌子上。

seasoning.en: The dish needs a little more seasoning, perhaps some salt and pepper.
seasoning.zh: 这道菜需要再加点调味料,比如一些盐和胡椒。

vinegar.en: Add a spoonful of vinegar to the sauce to give it a sharper taste.
vinegar.zh: 往酱汁里加一勺醋,味道会更酸爽。

wholegrain.en: Wholegrain bread and rice are better for you than the white kinds.
wholegrain.zh: 全谷物面包和糙米比白面包、白米更健康。

dietitian.en: My doctor sent me to a dietitian for advice on losing weight.
dietitian.zh: 医生让我去找营养师咨询减肥的建议。

gourmet.en: The food was so good that even a gourmet would have enjoyed it.
gourmet.zh: 菜做得太好了,连美食家也会喜欢。

gourmet.en: The village market sells gourmet cheeses from small farms in the area.
gourmet.zh: 村里的集市出售来自当地小农场的美食级奶酪。

bakery.en: The bakery on the corner sells fresh bread from seven every morning.
bakery.zh: 街角的面包店每天早上七点开始卖新鲜面包。

confectionery.en: The shop sells chocolates, sweets and other confectionery made by hand.
confectionery.zh: 这家店出售手工制作的巧克力、糖果和其他糖果糕点。

boutique.en: She works in a small boutique selling designer dresses and handbags.
boutique.zh: 她在一家卖名牌连衣裙和手提包的小精品店工作。

snack.en: You can buy a snack from the machine next to the lecture hall.
snack.zh: 你可以在报告厅旁边的售货机上买零食。

cocktail.en: The hotel bar serves a free cocktail to guests on their first night.
cocktail.zh: 酒店酒吧在客人入住第一晚免费赠送一杯鸡尾酒。

barbecue.en: If the weather stays fine, we'll have a barbecue in the garden on Sunday.
barbecue.zh: 如果天气一直这么好,我们周日就在花园里烧烤。

brunch.en: We usually meet for brunch on Sundays at about eleven o'clock.
brunch.zh: 我们通常周日十一点左右见面吃早午餐。

greasy.en: The chips were so greasy that I couldn't finish them.
greasy.zh: 薯条太油腻了,我没吃完。

savoury.en: Would you prefer something savoury, like cheese, or something sweet?
savoury.zh: 您想吃点咸的,比如奶酪,还是甜的?

fragrant.en: The kitchen was fragrant with the smell of fresh herbs and garlic.
fragrant.zh: 厨房里飘着新鲜香草和大蒜的香味。

nourish.en: Good soup can nourish you when you're getting over a cold.
nourish.zh: 感冒快好时,喝点好汤能补充营养。

convenience-store.en: There's a convenience store near the flat that stays open until midnight.
convenience-store.zh: 公寓附近有一家开到午夜的便利店。

fitting-room.en: The fitting room is at the back, if you'd like to try it on.
fitting-room.zh: 如果想试穿,试衣间在后面。

shopping-spree.en: I went on a shopping spree after getting my first month's pay.
shopping-spree.zh: 拿到第一个月工资后,我去疯狂购物了一番。

staple-food.en: Rice is the staple food for many families in this part of Asia.
staple-food.zh: 在亚洲这一地区,大米是许多家庭的主食。

mall.en: We spent the afternoon at the mall looking for a birthday present.
mall.zh: 我们下午在购物中心找生日礼物。

outlet.en: The factory outlet on Mill Road sells last year's coats at half price.
outlet.zh: 磨坊路上的工厂直销店半价出售去年款的大衣。

outlet.en: There is a power outlet under each desk in the study room.
outlet.zh: 自习室每张书桌下面都有一个电源插座。

parcel.en: A parcel came for you this morning, so I left it in your room.
parcel.zh: 今天早上有你的包裹,我放在你房间了。

swap.en: Could I swap this shirt for a smaller one, please?
swap.zh: 我可以把这件衬衫换成小一号的吗?

dining.en: The hotel's dining room is open from seven until ten every evening.
dining.zh: 酒店餐厅每晚七点到十点营业。

feast.en: The village holds a great feast with music at the end of harvest.
feast.zh: 收获季结束时,村里会举办盛宴,还有音乐表演。

coupon.en: Use this coupon to get free coffee with any sandwich.
coupon.zh: 用这张优惠券,买任意三明治都送一杯免费咖啡。

fry.en: Fry the onions gently in butter until they turn soft and golden.
fry.zh: 用黄油小火煎洋葱,直到变软变金黄。

roast.en: Roast the chicken for about an hour until the skin is crisp.
roast.zh: 把鸡烤一小时左右,直到外皮酥脆。

roast.en: We usually have roast beef with vegetables for Sunday lunch.
roast.zh: 我们周日午餐通常吃烤牛肉配蔬菜。

slice.en: Would you like another slice of cake before you go?
slice.zh: 你走之前要再来一片蛋糕吗?

slice.en: Slice the tomatoes thinly and put them on top of the cheese.
slice.zh: 把番茄切成薄片,放在奶酪上面。

loaf.en: Could you pick up a loaf of bread on your way home?
loaf.zh: 你回家路上能买一条面包吗?

appetite.en: I had no appetite for days after I got back from the trip.
appetite.zh: 旅行回来后,我好几天都没有食欲。

flavour.en: Fresh herbs add a lot of flavour to a simple tomato sauce.
flavour.zh: 新鲜香草能让简单的番茄酱风味大增。

account.en: I'd like to open an account for my wages, please.
account.zh: 我想开一个账户用来收工资。

current-account.en: A current account lets you pay bills and take out money at any time.
current-account.zh: 活期账户可以让你随时支付账单和取钱。

savings-account.en: I put a little money into my savings account every month.
savings-account.zh: 我每个月往储蓄账户里存一点钱。

joint-account.en: My partner and I opened a joint account to pay the rent and bills.
joint-account.zh: 我和伴侣开了一个联名账户,用来付房租和账单。

deposit.en: You need to pay a deposit of £50 to hold the room.
deposit.zh: 你需要付 50 英镑定金来保留这个房间。

deposit.en: You can deposit cash at the machines inside the bank until eight.
deposit.zh: 你可以在八点前用银行内的机器存入现金。

withdraw.en: You can withdraw up to £300 a day from any cash machine.
withdraw.zh: 你每天可以从任何一台取款机取款,最多 300 英镑。

withdrawal.en: There's no charge for a withdrawal from machines at our own branches.
withdrawal.zh: 在我们自己网点的机器上取款不收费。

balance.en: You can check your account balance at any cash machine.
balance.zh: 你可以在任何一台取款机上查询账户余额。

balance.en: It's hard to find a balance between part-time work and my studies.
balance.zh: 很难在兼职和学习之间找到平衡。

balance.en: Students must learn to balance their spending against their income each month.
balance.zh: 学生必须学会每月平衡自己的支出和收入。

statement.en: Your monthly statement shows every payment you've made from the account.
statement.zh: 你的月度对账单显示了从账户支出的每一笔款项。

statement.en: The bank issued a statement apologising for the problems with its website.
statement.zh: 这家银行发表声明,就网站出现的问题道歉。

interest-rate.en: The bank offers a low interest rate on loans for students.
interest-rate.zh: 银行为学生贷款提供较低的利率。

overdraft.en: The bank charges a small fee if you go over your overdraft limit.
overdraft.zh: 如果超出透支额度,银行会收取一小笔费用。

loan.en: I took out a loan to pay for my car.

mortgage.en: They had to take out a large mortgage to buy their first home.
mortgage.zh: 他们不得不申请一大笔按揭贷款来买第一套房。

credit-card.en: You can pay by credit card or in cash at the front desk.
credit-card.zh: 你可以在前台用信用卡或现金付款。

debit-card.en: A debit card takes the money directly from your bank account.
debit-card.zh: 借记卡会直接从你的银行账户扣款。

cheque.en: We no longer accept payment by cheque, only by card or cash.
cheque.zh: 我们不再接受支票付款,只收银行卡或现金。

instalment.en: You can pay for the course in three monthly instalments.
instalment.zh: 你可以分三个月分期支付课程费用。

fee.en: The bank charges a monthly fee of £5 for this account.
fee.zh: 这个账户银行每月收取 5 英镑费用。

charge.en: There's a small charge for using the swimming pool at weekends.
charge.zh: 周末使用游泳池要收取少量费用。

charge.en: The hotel will charge you for any drinks taken from the fridge.
charge.zh: 冰箱里的饮料一经取用,酒店将向你收费。

charge.en: Police decided to charge the driver with careless driving after the accident.
charge.zh: 事故发生后,警方决定以驾驶疏忽罪控告这名司机。

identification.en: You'll need some form of identification to open an account here.
identification.zh: 在这里开户需要提供某种身份证明。

proof-of-address.en: A recent gas bill can be used as proof of address.
proof-of-address.zh: 最近的煤气费账单可以用作地址证明。

signature.en: We need your signature at the bottom of the second page.
signature.zh: 我们需要你在第二页底部签名。

pin.en: Never tell anyone your PIN, even if they say they work for the bank.
pin.zh: 绝不要把银行卡密码告诉任何人,即使对方自称是银行员工。

online-banking.en: With online banking, you can pay your bills from your phone at any time.
online-banking.zh: 有了网上银行,你可以随时用手机支付账单。

branch.en: Our nearest branch is on the High Street, next to the post office.
branch.zh: 我们最近的分行在高街,紧邻邮局。

branch.en: A large branch fell from the tree and damaged the roof of the shed.
branch.zh: 一根大树枝从树上掉下来,砸坏了棚屋的屋顶。

cashpoint.en: Is there a cashpoint near here where I can get some money?
cashpoint.zh: 这附近有可以取钱的自动取款机吗?

budget.en: We have a budget of about £800 for the whole holiday.
budget.zh: 我们整个假期的预算大约是 800 英镑。

expenditure.en: Students should keep a record of their weekly income and expenditure.
expenditure.zh: 学生应该记录每周的收入和开支。

tuition-fee.en: The tuition fee for this course is higher for overseas students.
tuition-fee.zh: 这门课程对海外学生收取的学费更高。

scholarship.en: She won a scholarship that covers all her costs for three years.
scholarship.zh: 她获得了一笔奖学金,可以支付三年的全部费用。

grant.en: Some students can apply for a government grant to help with living costs.
grant.zh: 部分学生可以申请政府补助金来支付生活费。

grant.en: The college may grant you extra time if you are ill.
grant.zh: 如果你生病了,学院可能会给你额外的时间。

allowance.en: My parents give me a small monthly allowance while I'm at university.
allowance.zh: 我上大学期间,父母每月给我一小笔零用钱。

teller.en: The teller asked to see my passport before giving me the money.
teller.zh: 银行出纳员要求先看我的护照才把钱给我。

denomination.en: The machine only gives out notes in a denomination of twenty pounds.
denomination.zh: 这台机器只吐面额二十英镑的钞票。

documentation.en: You must bring the correct documentation when you apply for a bank account.
documentation.zh: 申请银行账户时必须带齐相关证明文件。

transaction.en: Every transaction you make will appear on your monthly statement.
transaction.zh: 你的每笔交易都会显示在月度对账单上。

savings.en: I used all my savings to pay for the trip to Canada.
savings.zh: 我把所有积蓄都用来支付去加拿大的旅行了。

premium.en: The insurance premium goes up each year as you get older.
premium.zh: 保险费会随着年龄增长逐年上涨。

premium.en: Premium seats cost more, but they have a much better view of the stage.
premium.zh: 优质座位更贵,但看舞台的视野好得多。

remuneration.en: Remuneration for the job includes a basic salary plus a company car.
remuneration.zh: 这份工作的报酬包括基本工资和一辆公司配车。

reimburse.en: The company will reimburse your travel costs if you keep the tickets.
reimburse.zh: 只要保留车票,公司就会报销你的差旅费。

rebate.en: You may be able to claim a tax rebate if you've paid too much.
rebate.zh: 如果多缴了税,你也许可以申请部分退款。

collateral.en: The bank asked him to use his house as collateral for the loan.
collateral.zh: 银行要求他用房子作为这笔贷款的抵押品。

audit.en: An outside company carries out an audit of the club's accounts every year.
audit.zh: 每年都由外部公司对俱乐部的账目进行审计。

bank-statement.en: You'll need to show a recent bank statement to rent the flat.
bank-statement.zh: 租这套公寓需要出示最近的银行对账单。

credit-limit.en: My credit limit is £1,000, so I can't pay for the whole trip.
credit-limit.zh: 我的信用额度是 1000 英镑,所以付不起全部旅费。

handling-fee.en: A small handling fee is added when you buy tickets over the phone.
handling-fee.zh: 电话购票要加收一小笔手续费。

down-payment.en: We saved for five years to make a down payment on the house.
down-payment.zh: 我们攒了五年钱,才付得起这套房子的首付。

identity-card.en: Please show your identity card at the door when you arrive.
identity-card.zh: 到达时请在门口出示你的身份证。

pay-slip.en: Your pay slip shows how much tax you've paid this month.
pay-slip.zh: 你的工资单显示了你这个月缴了多少税。

payable.en: The full amount is payable when you collect the car.
payable.zh: 全部款项在提车时支付。

sterling.en: The hotel only accepts payment in sterling, not in euros.
sterling.zh: 这家酒店只接受英镑付款,不收欧元。

invoice.en: We'll send you an invoice when the work has been finished.
invoice.zh: 工作完成后,我们会把发票寄给你。

lender.en: Most lenders will want to see proof of your income first.
lender.zh: 大多数贷款方都会先要求查看你的收入证明。

lottery.en: He spent the money he won on the lottery on a new house.
lottery.zh: 他用彩票中奖的钱买了一栋新房子。

bid.en: Someone made a bid of £200 for the old painting at the sale.
bid.zh: 拍卖会上有人出价 200 英镑买这幅旧画。

bid.en: Three local companies will bid for the contract to build the new library.
bid.zh: 当地三家公司将投标建造新图书馆的合同。
